public_safe_summary: Owner directs autonomous overnight advancement of the Second Brain Control Tower toward an enterprise-grade mandatory execution gateway, including coordinated multi-worker scheduling, collision prevention, progress visibility, and robust recovery.
desired_effect: Make system-relevant Owner inputs enter governed Signal intake first and require fresh Control Tower admission before formal engineering execution, while safely advancing already-approved work during sleep mode.
problem_to_solve: Execution has historically depended too much on individual chat windows remembering to consult the Control Tower, and multi-worker progress is not yet completely projected into one globally reconciled scheduling view.
success_condition: Future governed execution cannot obtain a writer or executor release without fresh Signal reconciliation and Control Tower admission, concurrent workers expose collision-safe progress and next-gate state, and degraded Tower conditions fail closed except for explicitly bounded Tower repair work.
